meta.audience: people who keep their own neighbourhood map: the alley café, the bakery, the walk between them
meta.title: OFFGRID
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/index.css, src/styles in the app repository), its sample places and walks and its captured screens. Lime #D7F75B on near-black #0B0B0C, the map darkened by the app's own filter (grayscale(1) invert(1) brightness(0.76) contrast(1.24)) over OpenStreetMap tiles; pins, lines and the title slab drawn from the app's own CSS and icon paths.

source.notes: a local map off the tourist grid: alley shops and walks left by locals, a walk drawn point by point with its distance and time, shared in one link

the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/map.json (its dark map at three zooms with the app's own marker positions, geo_*.txt) and capture/ui.json (its title slab, neighbourhood bar, a place, the Seongsu walk and its share dialog)
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's two colours: lime #D7F75B (pins, the walk, the title slab) on near-black #0B0B0C / #141416 / #1B1B1E, text #F3F3EE / #C4C4BC / #95958D; the second walk's cyan #7DF9FF appears only on the overview.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 for the name in the app's slab (black on lime, -0.062em) and 800 for headlines in warm white over the dark map; JetBrains Mono capitals for the app's labels (LOCAL MAP / SEOUL, 01 SEONGSU).
rationale.motion: A camera over a real map: one continuous push from Seoul to an alley in Seongsu across three captured zoom levels, pins that drop in, a walk that draws itself at walking pace while a dot walks it and the distance counts up.
rationale.sound: Swing in Bb major at 96 BPM (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s): an unhurried walking groove for a map of strolls, with soft organic SFX for pins and steps.
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the push from Seoul into Seongsu under the name and the app's line; the alley places dropping onto the map with a place's own card; the Seongsu walk drawing itself with its distance and time; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the share link.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
